subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — scheduling and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 22:24:00 +0000
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — follow up and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the quick discovery call today. Really helpful to hear about the way Nimbus is routing user queries and the real-time inference requirements. As discussed, the best next step is a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) where we can: 

- Walk through your traffic profile (qps, batch sizes, peak windows)
- Align on latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99 targets) and tail behavior expectations
- Discuss model variants and any quantization or KV cache constraints
- Review a draft mutual action plan and timing for Dedicated rollout

Proposed agenda: 30-45m technical session + 15m for commercial/next steps.

Can you confirm who from your infra/ML infra team should join? I suggest including your infra lead so we can map networking and VPC needs.

Here are a few slot options (PST):
- Thu Nov 5 — 10:00-11:00 PT (17:00-18:00 UTC)
- Thu Nov 5 — 13:00-14:00 PT (20:00-21:00 UTC)
- Fri Nov 6 — 09:00-10:00 PT (16:00-17:00 UTC)

I’ve attached a capacity-sizing template you can fill out if helpful (traffic pattern, p95 latencies, model configs). If you can drop your expected sustained QPS and peak QPS in the template before the call, we’ll use that to produce an initial sizing recommendation.

Attachments: capacity-sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@nimbus.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 23:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — follow up and next steps

Thanks Marissa — great call from our side as well.

We’ll definitely want to include Priya Natarajan (our Head of Infrastructure) and Jordan Blake (Platform Engineering) on the sizing session. Priya's email is priya.natarajan@nimbus.ai and Jordan is jordan.blake@nimbus.ai.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Sustained QPS: ~1,200 requests/sec
- Peak QPS (30-min burst): ~4,500 requests/sec
- Typical request payload size: ~1.2k tokens average (mostly short queries, some long-form syntheses)
- Current p95 latency: ~310ms (we’d like to get p95 down to <200ms for interactive workflows)

I attached a CSV export of our Oct traffic sample to give you a starting point.

Preferred slots: Thu Nov 5 10:00 PT works for Priya and Jordan. Can you confirm a calendar invite & dial-in? Also please include the meeting agenda and any infra pre-reqs (VPC peering, firewall rules) so Priya can review ahead of time.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product — Nimbus AI
alex.johnson@nimbus.ai

Attachments: nimbus-qps-2026-10.csv (CSV, 45KB)

Alex —

Perfect — I’ve scheduled Thu Nov 5 at 10:00 PT and sent a calendar invite (link below). Priya and Jordan are on the invite. Agenda and pre-reads are attached.

Agenda (30-45m technical + 15m commercial):
1) Quick intros & success criteria (5m)
2) Traffic profile walkthrough (sustained vs peak QPS) (10m)

Pre-reqs for the call:
